summary.text: Patrick Marnell is the Libertarian candidate for Oregon House of Representatives District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Roy Kaufmann and Republican Amanda Staehely in a race with no incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Marnell was the Libertarian candidate for Oregon House District 18 in 2016, when incumbent Victor Gilliam defeated Democrat Tom Kane and Marnell.
In 2020 Marnell was the Libertarian candidate for Oregon State Senate District 9, where he received 2.8 percent of the vote and incumbent Fred Girod won.
